report_name: Shropshire Local Cycling & Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify desire lines for cycle movements by highlighting routes currently used by commuter cyclists and forecasting the number of commuter cyclists under the government target.
other_tools_developed: A bespoke appraisal framework consisting of 26 metrics (21 for Effectiveness & Needs Based Appraisal and 5 for Deliverability) used to rank schemes.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP process resulted in the identification of 10 top-scoring prioritised infrastructure schemes across Oswestry, Shrewsbury, and Ludlow, and established a framework for future funding applications through mechanisms such as the Capability & Ambition Fund, Active Travel Fund, and developer contributions.
pct_usage_quote: The PCT was also used to forecast the number of commuter cyclists on these routes under the government target (as set out in the Second Cycling and Walking Investment Strategy) to double cycling at a national level.
